ms.text: Pernah tak, tengah memandu, tiba-tiba isyarat internet hilang?
Kenalkan FGMaps. Aplikasi navigasi untuk Malaysia.
Muat turun pek peta Malaysia sekali sahaja. Selepas itu, laluan dikira terus dalam telefon anda, walaupun tanpa internet.
Arahan belok demi belok tetap berjalan, lengkap dengan suara panduan dalam Bahasa Melayu atau English.
Kereta tiga dimensi, kamera yang bergerak automatik, dan laluan semula bila anda tersasar.
Nak laluan yang mana? Sehingga sepuluh pilihan, termasuk yang terpantas, terpendek, atau tanpa tol, lengkap dengan beza masa dan jarak.
Anggaran tol dikira daripada kadar rasmi, jadi anda tahu kos sebelum bertolak. Anggaran kos minyak pun ada.
Simpan Rumah dan Kerja untuk sampai dengan satu ketukan. Cari stesen minyak, tempat makan, masjid, tandas dan parkir berhampiran.
Pemandu motosikal pun tidak ketinggalan. Dan butang kecemasan sentiasa dekat.
Siang atau malam, pilih tema cerah, gelap atau hitam AMOLED. Boleh juga ikut matahari secara automatik.
Dan yang paling best, semuanya percuma. Tiada akaun, tiada iklan, tiada langganan, tiada penjejakan.
FGMaps. Navigasi untuk Malaysia. Segera hadir.

en.text: Ever been driving, and suddenly your internet signal just disappears?
The map freezes. And you're left guessing.
Meet FGMaps. A navigation app made for Malaysia.
Download the Malaysia pack once. After that, routes are calculated right on your phone, even with no internet.
Turn-by-turn guidance keeps working, with voice directions in Malay or English.
A 3D car, a camera that moves automatically, and rerouting whenever you miss a turn.
Which way do you want to go? Up to ten route options, including the fastest, the shortest, or no tolls, with time and distance differences.
Toll estimates come from official rates, so you know the cost before you leave. Fuel cost estimates are there too.
Save Home and Work to get there in one tap. Find fuel, food, mosques, toilets and parking nearby.
Motorcycle riders are covered too. And the emergency button is always close.
Day or night, choose light, dark or AMOLED black. Or let it follow the sun automatically.
And best of all, it's completely free. No account, no ads, no subscription, no tracking.
FGMaps. Navigation for Malaysia. Coming soon.
